about_the_game:
Note:

  • The game is still in its early stages of development.

  • New features and changes coming soon!!

  • Current screenshots and playtest do NOT reflect the final version

-------

A strange portal from the moon rips open your world 

As the last summoner, you command ancient magic. Build your loyal party

or watch your world fall to monstrous tides 

Features

  • Adapt on the fly: build your party mid-fight with units and spells that suit your style 

  • Outsmart brutal bosses by reading their attacks and setting up devastating combos 

  • Quick 10-minute runs keep the tension high and the pace fast 

  • After every fight, your team dissolves, but your will to survive hardens. Each reset is a new chance to outsmart the moon’s horrors 

This game will offer:

  • Auto battle combat. You will pick options based on the current situation. The turn plays out automatically

  • Arcade progression. Difficulty rises based on the win streak

  • Procedurally generated run

  • Short choice to result loop

  • Chaos

This game will NOT offer:

  • Deep complicated story

  • Long run. A battle is treated as a run; you will start anew on each battle.

  • Simple mechanics

-------

I need you to wishlist Maw the Moon, even if you won't play it; it only takes 2 seconds, and it will help more players discover it
